body.label: Effect
body.html: Enter a predictive trance until the start of your next turn. Gain +1 Defense against the first Action that targets you.

surges.html: Ignore line of sight for one target you can otherwise locate within this card's range.
If this effect targets one mind, it may also convey a brief thought or sensory impression.

rider.title: TRANCE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the Trance lasts through the end of your next turn.
